source: the reference implementation's own measured value: the reference cphys materials (solution/ref/params.json), calibrated by tests/review/make_ref.py against the real fabrics (tests/creal.py) on calibration tests drawn separately from the hidden tests. Eight oracle measurements of this reference on the hidden tests all gave 0.66127 (A 0.790, B 0.793, C 0.401) with identical per-test qualities: three ale validate runs on Linux amd64 (validate-2ec6d466, validate-d425c427, validate-43d172ff) and five host-side gradings through the grader's code on arm64 macOS (with 3, 4 and 6 worker processes). full_at 0.9: the measured spread is zero; the margin covers a host whose floating point flips one knife-edge test (one test of 18 moves the score by at most 1/18, about 8.4% of the anchor)
